execution.interpretation: Submarine threat is real, but current Branch ASW and the historical lift outcome do not justify inventing a tank-cargo catastrophe. Vehicles require post-unload maintenance before full readiness.

15Apr_state.Saipan: main regiment elements unloaded; serviceability climbing toward 90-96% 5-10 days after unload; defensive training/position preparation begins.
15Apr_state.Guam: forwarded companies unloaded or completing unload/maintenance; not instant full readiness.

strategic_effect: Marianas ground defense becomes materially harder without consuming the carrier core. This strengthens Yamamoto's rationale for preserving mobile naval power for a fixed US amphibious geometry rather than raiding east blindly.
